title: At The Dot
desc: Two journalists driving to an army camp through a desolate highway debate on the ethics of their work due to the differing ideologies they hold.

title: Ava
desc: An actress on her way to an audition meets a pair of potentially dangerous men, leading to an anxiety-filled road trip.

title: Interstate
desc: When a Homeland Security agent shows up at his door, Joaquin will need to make a tough choice.

title: Fear Of Haha
desc: A young man wakes up to find himself transported to an abandoned yard where he is attacked by every man he sees.

desc: This is Film - Drama Category.

title: Ghazaal
desc: An award-winning drama. A teenage refugee scrapes by in a settlement camp by selling items and clothes, but she becomes increasingly desperate when she receives her period.

title: Teacher
desc: A teacher comes to know that his students are being bullied outside class. He then takes it upon himself to punish the bullies.

desc: A young man sacrifices his personal life to look after his single mother. However, a new revelation casts a different light on their relationship.

title: Grey Collar
desc: Three identical strangers embark on a journey which leads to dangerous predicament.

title: Intezaar
desc: In a part of London with a strong Indian presence, an elderly woman originally from India anxiously awaits word of a community party invitation.

desc: A couple confronts hidden memories, revealing truths to each other and themselves, embarking on a transformative journey of self-discovery.

desc: A hired killer accepts a contract to eliminate a target, a beautiful woman. He decides to romantically persuade her rather than resort to violence.

title: Kanche
desc: Om reads a book on ghosts and tries the kajal trick at school with his best friend, Mona. But they are caught and punished by their teacher.

desc: Aavarti is a film that revolves around the ignorant cruel society that steals the innocence of childhood of many children like a school-going Lakshmi that sells wares at traffic signals.

desc: Two individuals, a middle-aged woman with a cold exterior and a homeless taxi-driver, cross paths only to learn that life goes on despite the loneliness plaguing it.

desc: Unable to save an innocent child in communal riots, a guilt-ridden Hindu man befriends a young Muslim boy. However, his life is disturbed when he is asked to testify against some Hindu goons.

desc: In a near future where abortion is now re-criminalised, Kara is faced with a sad and brutal reality. Despite the imminent dangers she faces, she seeks out an illegal mobile abortion clinic.

desc: An Aid worker's experience of death is told through nine different voice.

desc: The filmmaker shines light upon the gender diversity amongst youth while embracing each of their various stories.

desc: Eight-year-old Sam is desperate for an allotment. When he meets Norman, a curmudgeonly old man with a neglected allotment and a death wish, Sam thinks he has the solution to both of their problems.

desc: An unapologetic woman is ready to break the mould by questioning and changing the narrative of who she has been conditioned by society to become.
